note: The tablet sidebar's tab drag under a real finger (TABLET-03): a hold lifts the row (the ghost at scale 1.02 under the level-2 shadow), the finger carried across another row shows the caret in the gap the rows slide open, the release reorders the core's track; an overflowing list – a plain swipe scrolls and lifts nothing, a lifted row held in the finger's 56 px band at the top edge has the list scroll up under it to the Research header (the into-target, as today) and one held at the bottom edge has it scroll down (time-based on touch; the speed read) to a slot it lands in; a drop onto the Research header joins the group and a drop beside a loose row leaves it; reduced motion where the WebView reflects it; the lift and the drop mark again in the dark scheme.
